QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`) ... installs its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` and `buffer_alloc_free` through `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator uses the runtime setter from its init function, but it never says it is the only in-tree user of that setter.
